name: Underlying Product Identifier 1 Code
definition: Indicates the underlying product type for reporting to trade repositories. These product codes must be in line with the ISDA Product Taxonomy.

FORW.name: Foreign Exchange Forward
FORW.definition: Underlying product type of the transaction is a Foreign Exchange Forward.

NDFO.name: Foreign Exchange Non Deliverable Forward
NDFO.definition: Underlying product type of the transaction is a Foreign Exchange Non Deliverable Forward.

SPOT.name: Foreign Exchange Spot
SPOT.definition: Underlying product type of the transaction is Foreign Exchange Spot.

SWAP.name: Foreign Exchange SWAP
SWAP.definition: Underlying product type of the transaction is a Foreign Exchange SWAP.
